prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for a desktop utility app
Primary request: Design the complete 600 by 780 desktop window for Clickity, a modern cross-platform autoclicker used primarily during gaming. Use the approved Quick Panel visual world: carbon #17191d and graphite #25282e surfaces, warm off-white #f4f4f0 type, chartreuse #b9e44c active state, steel #737983 secondary marks; layered overlay-tray depth, broad selection rails, chunky segmented toggles, strong spacing, medium rounded corners, matte surfaces, no glow. Composition C — Balanced Split: use a compact brand/status header, then a two-column control field where a wider left column owns the four-part interval and repeat limit while a narrower right column owns mouse-button and cursor-position choices. A full-width contextual fixed-position tray bridges both columns only when needed. Place the shortcut and run-state copy in a quiet footer row above a wide chartreuse “Start clicking” button. Preserve all existing features and validation space.
Composition/framing: straight-on portrait desktop application, exact full window visible, no device hardware, no surrounding scene. High fidelity and production-plausible, with clear focus states and minimum comfortable target sizes.
Typography: compact modern humanist sans with rounded terminals; numerals may use a slightly narrower companion. Keep the two-column hierarchy calm and obvious.
Exact interface text to render where legible: “Clickity”, “Clicks, right on cue.”, “Idle”, “Click interval”, “Hours”, “Minutes”, “Seconds”, “Milliseconds”, “Every 1 second”, “Mouse button”, “Left”, “Middle”, “Right”, “Repeat”, “Count”, “Until stopped”, “Cursor position”, “Follow cursor”, “Fixed position”, “Capture”, “Start / stop shortcut”, “F6”, “Ready when you are”, “Start clicking”. Do not add other claims or capabilities.
Constraints: This is an operating interface, not a landing page. Balance overview and density while preserving every existing setting. No sidebar navigation. No invented presets, profiles, stats, accounts, cloud features, or game integrations.
Avoid: OP Auto Clicker imitation, Windows legacy controls, generic neon RGB gamer dashboard, glassmorphism, gradients, glow, glossy 3D, bento-card collage, excessive pills, tiny text, marketing copy, watermark.
